{{Quote|Good luck Obi-Wan. And may the Force be with you!|Asha to Kenobi before the mission|<ref name="Star Wars: Obi-Wan">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]</ref>}}
The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] undertook a '''rescue mission''' in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] after escorting the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] home from her mission to speak to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. The mission took place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and was executed under the cover of darkness. [[Asha (Naboo)|Asha]], a servant who had become a leader of the [[Naboo Resistance]], contacted Kenobi and asked him to rescue several [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Security Force]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who had been captured and were being held in the Palace Observatory. Kenobi started near the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] and defended himself against [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s. After disabling the alarm, he faced [[E4 baron droid]]s. Kenobi then crossed the bridge to the Observatory and eliminated a pair of [[Trade Federation assassin droid]]s. He then rescued the pilots, and the [[Unidentified squad leader|squad leader]] agreed to join with the Resistance. Kenobi retraced his steps, leading the pilots back to the Palace. Kenobi struck down more droids, including [[bomb droid]]s. Once near the Palace, Kenobi fought with the resistance against 2 more baron droids and finished his mission. The next day Kenobi and the pilots joined in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|battle to retake Theed]].

==Prelude==
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] undertook a rescue mission in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], which was occupied by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. He worked with the [[Naboo Resistance]] under the command of [[Asha (Naboo)|Asha]]. Kenobi was tasked with rescuing [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Security Force]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who had been captured and were being held as prisoners of war by the invading battle droids in the Palace Observatory.

==The battle==
{{Quote|Thank you, Jedi. You've got to help us get back to the resistance fighters. We'll follow you, but we'll hang back until the coast is clear.|The squad leader to Kenobi|<ref name="Star Wars: Obi-Wan" />}}
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)}}
Kenobi started near the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace's]] waterfall and ascended up to the next level. He fought through a group of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s and sliced through the alarm system with his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's first lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], disabling it.

Once in the streets, he was pinned down by two [[Moog-3000 Death Synthesizer|repeater cannons]]. He flanked the cannons and eliminated the droids manning them. Continuing along to the observatory, he faced two [[E4 baron droid]]s and a squad of [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|OOM security battle droids]]. He then crossed the bridge connecting the Palace to the Observatory and eliminated the battle droids and the two [[Trade Federation assassin droid]]s. He also used a [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] to eliminate droid snipers at the top of the Observatory. Kenobi jumped up and infiltrated the Observatory through a side window and eliminated the droids guarding the six pilots. He shut down the force field holding them in place, and the [[Unidentified squad leader|squad leader]] agreed to help him. The pilots held back while Kenobi retraced his steps back to the Palace. On the bridge, Kenobi fought two more assassin droids. The pilots then moved to the courtyard, where Kenobi fought more battle droids supplemented by [[bomb droid]]s. With those threats taken care of, Kenobi led the pilots back toward the Palace. They then held back while Kenobi dueled 2 more assassin droids and bomb droids. Kenobi then joined up with the [[Naboo Resistance]] to fight near the Palace, and helped them take out 2 baron droids. With the mission done, Asha congratulated the young Jedi.
{{Endgame}}

==Aftermath==
The next day, Kenobi, Asha, and the pilots participated in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|battle to retake Theed]], in which Kenobi was instrumental in taking out a [[Quad turbolaser cannon (Trade Federation)|quad turbolaser cannon]].

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appears in the ''[[2001]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']] during the game's fifth chapter.
